collection.title: Mercedes-Benz 190 1987 to 1993 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description:
The Mercedes-Benz 190 Saloon 1987 to 1993 model requires a 24" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
Fitting Guide: Due to the Eccentric-sweep wiper motion you will need to turn pre-mounted adaptor 180 degrees.
